programme.title: WWII War Diaries

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.
